data.title: Claude adds dashboard and motion betas
data.summary: New October tools connect exploratory data questions and animated explainers to existing work.

sources.title: Build live dashboards and animate explainers with Claude

facts.text: On October 8, Anthropic announced Dashboards beta on paid plans and Motion beta on Team and Enterprise. Docs, Slides and Design left beta on all plans.
The provider describes query visibility and refresh timestamps for dashboard charts. Enterprise admins control availability; beta access is not universal.

prerequisites: Identify the intended host, task, source data and existing access.
steps: Inspect existing BI/dashboards and the authorized source connection before building a new view.
Pilot one known metric with explicit filters and compare its visible query and refresh time to the source.
For an explainer, reuse the approved figures and review the rendered motion before sharing.
data.output: A small reconciled dashboard pilot or source-checked explainer plan.
validation: Metric grain, filters and freshness match the source.
A visually polished output does not substitute for a numerical check.
limitations: Beta capability reported by the provider; no dashboard, connection or motion output was executed by Sintra.
